chat.summaryInitial: Hello! I'm Bob, the study assistant of Smart Study. I'm here to help! What topic would you like me to summarize today? Send me the subject for the summary.

You can also review your answers by clicking on an completed attempt. Let's get started! What topic would you like to quiz yourself on? Send me the subject for the quiz.

story.text: This project was conceived and developed by Information Systems student Carolina Lansoni Vilas Boas, who was mentored by the professor Rafael Hauckewitz Todaro, in partnership with the Instituto Mauá de Tecnologia and the global Grand Challenges Scholarship Program.
